description: Normalize one reported HLA allele name (any era or reporting shorthand: legacy A*0101, G/P group names, A*02:XX, two-field A*02:01g, optional HLA- prefix) to current 2-field form, with G group, P group, serologic equivalent, and flags. NMDP MAC codes (A*02:AB) are recognised but not expanded (flag mac_code).

name.description: One reported HLA allele name, any nomenclature era. An allele string only, never a patient name, medical record number or other identifier.

name: normalize_allele

allele_2field.description: Current 2-field form, or UNRESOLVABLE. Never present an UNRESOLVABLE name as an allele.

current_name.description: Current full name in the pinned release, or UNRESOLVABLE.

flags.description: e.g. deprecated_name, nonexistent_allele, null_allele, g_group_name, p_group_name, xx_code, lg_notation, mac_code.

g_group.description: G group; NONE (no group), AMBIGUOUS (members differ) or UNRESOLVABLE.
